what: Encode of the decoded twitter.cbor through ref_binding with sharedrefs::on, microseconds per document. Arm old: main 306088c. Arm new: three changes together, without a reserve: the write pass looks only at identities seen more than once (none: no lookup); seen is a std::pmr::unordered_map on a std::pmr::monotonic_buffer_resource that lives as long as one document; the count pass encodes no leaves.
why: The owner asked for the three measured changes together, without the guessed reserve.
how: Google Benchmark, one binary per arm, each built twice (a, b). 3 rounds alternating, --benchmark_min_time=0.1s --benchmark_repetitions=3, random interleaving, GLIBC_TUNABLES trim_threshold, mmap_threshold and top_pad high.
finding: old 1735/1799, new 1256/1252: 29 percent less. sharedrefs::off is about 266.

context.commit: mbedded-cbor main 306088c, arm new is a patch on it
